sources.entry: Codebase to Course by Zara Zhang - A Claude Code skill that turns any codebase into a beautiful, interactive single-page HTML course for non-technical vibe coders.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code skill that turns any codebase into a self-contained, interactive single-page HTML course for non-technical "vibe coders."
summary.what_it_does: You point the skill at a repository and it generates one HTML file that teaches how the code works. The course uses scroll-based modules with progress tracking and keyboard navigation. It shows code snippets alongside plain-English translations, and includes animated visualizations such as data-flow animations and architecture diagrams. Embedded quizzes ask the learner to apply concepts to new problems rather than recall definitions. Hover-tooltips give plain-English glossary definitions for technical terms. The README says the output has no dependencies and works offline.
use_cases: Learn how an existing app or GitHub project works without a CS background
Generate an interactive tutorial from a codebase for a team member
Understand what an AI-generated codebase is doing
Build intuition for architecture before steering an AI coding tool
Create an offline, shareable HTML walkthrough of a repo
how_to_run: Open any project in Claude Code
Say: "Turn this codebase into an interactive course"
notable: Outputs a single self-contained HTML file with no dependencies that works offline
Side-by-side code and plain-English translations using exact, unmodified snippets from the real codebase
Quizzes test application of concepts to new scenarios instead of memorization
Each concept gets a distinct metaphor rather than reused analogies
Built around a 'build first, understand later' approach aimed at vibe coders
caveats: README does not describe limits on codebase size or language support
Requires Claude Code and installing the skill folder into ~/.claude/skills/
README does not state a license
